Done. Here's a summary of what I did:

## Summary

**Problem:** checkout-api was failing health checks after the latest deploy (v2.3.1) in all production regions, with an elevated error rate (0.18).

**Actions taken:**
1. **Investigated** — `get_service_status` confirmed v2.3.1 was unhealthy in all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west). Deployment history showed v2.3.1 was the only unhealthy production release; the most recent healthy production release was **v2.3.0** (v2.2.9 was also healthy but older).
2. **Rolled back** to v2.3.0 in all production regions. The first attempt partially completed (us-east only) due to an orchestrator error, so I retried and the rollback completed across all regions.
3. **Opened a SEV2 incident** (INC-0001) titled "checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy" describing the failure and the rollback. (The first create call timed out, but the incident was actually created — confirmed via `list_incidents`.)

**Final state:** checkout-api is on **v2.3.0** in all regions, **healthy**, with error rate back down to 0.002. The incident INC-0001 remains open for follow-up on the root cause of the v2.3.1 regression.
